Nina Park: Quick non-work poll: if you could pick one useless superpower (completely impractical), what would it be? :thinking:
Omar Haddad: The ability to perfectly fold fitted sheets. useless but life-changing. :raised_hands:
Liam O'Connor: Make any plant instantly remember to water itself. very niche.
Zoe Martinez: Speak fluent cat. 0% useful, 100% chaos. :cat:
Ravi Gupta: Detect where my other sock is. this is basically magic.
Nina Park: love these. bonus: what's the most useless-but-delightful app on your phone?
Omar Haddad: I have a cloud of virtual bubbles app. Tap to pop. 37MB of joy.
Liam O'Connor: A mock retro pager that only sends motivational one-word messages.
Zoe Martinez: Photo of my llama-themed flashlight (why did i buy this?) https://imgur.com/flashlightpic
Ravi Gupta: Winner: an app that plays ambient coffee shop noise. helps me focus in silence.
Nina Park: Thanks all. we'll compile the completely impractical superpowers for the next watercooler :grin:
